meta.title: Wetherspoons Leeds: a guide to pubs, menus and prices
meta.description: Explore Wetherspoons Leeds with pub locations, menu choices and pricing advice. Find your nearest listed pub and check breakfast and club details.

intro:
This guide covers {pubCount} open Wetherspoons pubs in Leeds across {areaCount} areas, helping you choose where to eat and what to check before ordering. Every pub works from the national [Wetherspoons menu](/), but prices are set locally. Find The Hedley Verity, The Cuthbert Brodrick and The Stick or Twist by area, alongside guidance on the national menu, local pricing, breakfast and club days.

SpoonsMenu is an independent guide, not affiliated with J D Wetherspoon plc. Use it to narrow your choice, then confirm current details with your chosen pub.
quickAnswer: We list {pubCount} open Wetherspoons pubs in Leeds: The Hedley Verity in City Centre, The Cuthbert Brodrick in Millennium Square and The Stick or Twist in Arena Quarter. These cover {areaCount} listed areas. Choose the location that suits your plans, then check that pub’s current menu and prices rather than assuming every branch charges the same.

areas.text: The Hedley Verity is the listed Wetherspoons pub in City Centre. It suits visitors who want their pub choice in that area rather than Millennium Square or Arena Quarter. Check its current menu and prices before deciding what to order, as a shared national menu does not mean identical bills.

The Cuthbert Brodrick is the listed Wetherspoons option in Millennium Square. Choose it if this is the area where you want to eat or meet. For a particular breakfast or main meal, confirm the current selection with the pub rather than relying solely on the national menu.

The Stick or Twist is the listed Wetherspoons pub in Arena Quarter. It suits anyone choosing a pub in this area rather than the other listed locations. If price is your deciding factor, check its current charges against your alternatives before settling on a meal.

pricing:
Wetherspoons menu prices in Leeds vary by pub, even though the menu is broadly the same nationally. Typical prices are a guide, not a promise of what your chosen branch will charge.

Central pubs often charge more than suburban ones, so location can affect the cost of a meal. That general pattern does not establish which of the listed pubs is cheapest, and there is no basis here for ranking them by price.

For the exact current price, check the menu at your chosen pub or select that location in the Wetherspoon app before ordering. Compare the same dish at each branch if cost matters more than location.
breakfastAndClubs:
Breakfast at Wetherspoons is typically served from eight in the morning until midday, while [Curry Club](/curry-club) traditionally runs on Thursday and [Steak Club](/steak-club) on Tuesday at participating pubs. For a Leeds visit, treat these as general timings and club days, then confirm arrangements with your chosen branch.

Traditional breakfast, curries and other familiar choices feature on the national menu, but that does not confirm a particular dish or club offer at every location. Check participation, the current selection and the pub’s own prices before planning your meal around a club day.

tips.text: Start with City Centre, Millennium Square or Arena Quarter, then choose the listed pub there. This keeps the decision focused on where you actually want to eat.

tips.title: Compare the same dish
tips.text: Check the same menu item at each pub when comparing costs. A broadly shared national menu makes comparison useful, but each branch sets its own prices.

tips.title: Confirm breakfast service
tips.text: Ask your chosen pub about breakfast service before making a special visit. The typical window runs from eight in the morning until midday, rather than confirmed local hours.

tips.title: Check club participation
tips.text: Confirm Curry Club or Steak Club with the pub before choosing your day. Traditional Thursday and Tuesday schedules apply at participating branches, not necessarily every location.

tips.title: Choose how to order
tips.text: You can order at the bar or at your table using the Wetherspoon app. If using the app, check that you have selected your intended pub.
